inlines.v: FONT, noun [Latin fundo, to pour out.] A large basin or stone vessel in which water is contained for baptizing children or other persons in the church. FONT, noun [Latin fundo, to pour out.] A complete assortment of printing types of one size, including a due proportion of all the letters in the alphabet, large and small, points, accents, and whatever else is necessary for printing with that letter.
